subject: The same table linked among different tabpanels

messages.author: da636f3145353d83
messages.subject: The same table linked among different tabpanels
parts:
Hi everyone,

can any expert give me any suggestions how to link my table 1 in tabpanel 1 and tabpanel 2
so that I can use part of the output table in tabpanel 1 to show/display in tabpanel 2 (instead of re-uploading everything).

Thanks

Mao

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: The same table linked among different tabpanels
parts:
Create a reactive expression to represent the information that you want to share between two or more outputs, and from those outputs' renderXXX functions, read from the reactive expression instead of performing the calculation right there.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/tutorial/lesson6/

There is another example at the bottom here:
http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#reactivity
